**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent)** — submitted.

- **Investigation:** A document-wide search for "insurance" returned no hits, and the section outline contains no insurance provision. IBM nonetheless hosts the e-business Hosting Environment (§ 5.3), bears risk of loss for Base Components (§ 14.12), and processes personal information on our behalf (§ 14.18) — squarely a vendor that touches our data.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New § 14.12A "Insurance" inserted after Risk of Loss, requiring IBM to maintain CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M (referencing Customer Components/Content and personal information processed on our behalf, since "Customer Data" is not a defined term here), statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request.
- **Direction check:** The obligation binds IBM only; no new burden on Bluefly. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) flagged in the comment for negotiation.
